package.description: Minimalistic QR code generator, as a desktop app and a command-line tool

en-US.description: Minimalistic QR code generator, as a desktop app and a command-line tool
en-US.longDescription:
qr2l creates QR codes from a desktop app (qr2l-gui) or from the command line (qr2l).
It recognizes what you type (links, email, phone numbers, SMS, WhatsApp, WiFi networks,
geolocation, contacts and calendar events) and offers a form for the types with more fields.
Codes can have custom colors and a logo in the middle, and are exported as PNG, SVG, PDF,
BMP, JPEG, WebP or PostScript. The command-line tool also sets the error correction level
and the module shape.
en-US.name: qr2l - QR Code Generator Tool
